title: Recording: Husbands And Wives by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr continued recording ‘Husbands And Wives’ for his fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, on 1 August 1974.

This was the third day in which the song was worked on. More overdubs for ‘Husbands And Wives’ were recorded on 14 and 20 August, and 1 October.
